Attacks on health workers and facilities
issues.summary_100: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in over 11,000 cases and high fatalities. Basic health measures are inadequate, with most cases detected outside surveillance systems. Children are particularly affected, contributing to rising death rates due to lack of care. Attacks on health workers and facilities have further complicated containment efforts. The Ebola outbreak is the deadliest of Congo’s 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016
